narrative.overview:
The page is editorial, warm, restrained, and quietly confident. Real engineering evidence leads: the engineer's role, grounded career metrics, and the project catalogue are easy to find, while the interface stays out of their way. Playfair Display gives the headlines character; Inter keeps navigation, detail, and long-form project content direct.

Obsidian and ivory provide the two surfaces, with brushed gold as the accent. Light is the default presentation; the theme control switches to dark and remembers an explicit choice. The hero's MA sun anchors five labeled skill planets: Swift, SwiftUI, Flutter, Dart, and Mobile. The user's reference images guide the layout and imagery; project mockups that could be mistaken for shipped work are excluded.
keyCharacteristics: Obsidian and soft ivory surfaces with warm gold accents.
Editorial serif headlines paired with clear sans-serif detail.
Mobile technology marks orbit a warm MA sun in the hero.
Real project descriptions, links, metrics, and Arabic content remain the proof.
The light theme is the default; dark mode is a persistent user choice.

rules.name: The Theme-Contrast Rule
rules.body: Use bright gold on obsidian and deep gold on ivory; do not carry the dark-theme accent unchanged into light-theme text.

rules.name: The Evidence-First Rule
rules.body: Use display typography to establish hierarchy; keep the supporting project facts in the readable sans-serif voice.

rules.name: The Real-Work Rule
rules.body: Project imagery must be genuine product evidence; generic or generated imagery must never imply that it is a shipped client interface.

dos: Do keep the orbital diagram's skill names visible and its movement reduced-motion safe.
Do preserve project facts, destinations, career metrics, and Arabic right-to-left content.
Do start in light mode and persist an explicit theme selection.
Do use the theme-specific gold token for readable accents.
donts: Don't present generated concept mockups as shipped applications.
Don't use stock photography as proof of Mostafa's identity or client work.
Don't replace the user's approved reference hierarchy with unrelated visual motifs.
